title: Fix Android backup publication permissions
changes: Replace hard-link publication of new cartridge backups on Android and Linux with atomic renameat2 no-replace; preserve the existing backup if the name already exists.
validation: On the connected moto g34 5G, isolated app-owned scratch rejected a hard link with Permission denied; a separate ARM64 probe run as the app verified renameat2 publication and collision refusal. Probe files were removed.

Serial host Rust tests passed 36 with 2 ignored in android-backup-noclobber-tests-s898l_es; ARM64 Docker build and Kotlin unit tests passed in android-backup-permission-fix-apk-hjq6ah6k; APK installed with adb install -r.
The user confirmed that Play opens the game on the phone after installation.
limitations: The real Play flow was confirmed by the user rather than independently observed; devices lacking renameat2 no-replace safely report an error instead of overwriting a backup.
